description:
VAO Blender is a security-conscious Blender extension for validating, inspecting, and importing supported Virtual Acoustic Object packages. Release 0.3.0-rc.1 implements the published VAO Standard 0.4.0 and retains isolated compatibility readers for VAO 0.3.2 and 0.2.2.

The extension verifies carrier structure, manifests, release binding, inventories, byte sizes, SHA-256 fixity, and immutable references before media access. It supports metadata inspection and exact embedded GLB visual-realization import while preserving package, asset, realization, frame, and pose provenance in Blender.

VAO Blender works offline, does not modify source packages, and does not execute packaged scripts. VAO 0.4.0 interaction/runtime execution, room-impulse-response convolution, acoustic simulation, and acoustic rendering are outside this release candidate's scope.
notes: Release candidate. Blender validated the Windows x64, macOS x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux x64 packages. The installed-extension smoke test was completed on macOS Apple Silicon; native installed-extension smoke tests on Windows x64, macOS x64, and Linux x64 remain follow-up work.
title: VAO Blender: A Blender Extension for Virtual Acoustic Objects
